attesa.description: Wait for your opponent to end their turn

fine.label: End
fine.description: Some end-of-turn effects are resolved before ending it

specialManaEffect.prismatic: Always worth 1 mana more than its own value, regardless of any other modifier active on the card.
specialManaEffect.vital: If you use it to pay for a spell that targets yourself, you recover 2 Health Points. Otherwise it counts as common mana.
specialManaEffect.chaotic: If you use it to pay for a spell that targets your opponent, it deals 2 extra damage. Otherwise it counts as common mana.

playerHud.frozenAria: Frozen: risk of drawing Freeze cards instead of useful ones

wand.title: Wand
wand.tipEffect: Hold a base element here to use it on the next turn, do so or it will be consumed.
wand.bodyEffect: Resistance to {element} damage, vulnerability to {opposite} damage
wand.handleEffect: You have a 20% chance to get +1 permanent mana on {element} when drawn
wand.handleEffectEmpty: You have a 10% chance to get +1 permanent mana on a base element as soon as it's drawn

fonte.description: Combine and remove two or more base elements to get an advanced element
fonte.residuoExpiry: Consumed at the end of the turn if not used.

socketDialog.title: Socket
socketDialog.dialogAria: Choose where to socket the element
socketDialog.warning: This choice is final: once socketed, this wand slot can never be changed for the rest of the match.

newGame.title: New Game
newGame.shareHint: Share the code with your opponent
newGame.hint: Generate a code and share it

errors.game-full-or-started: The game is already full or has started.
errors.already-host: You're already the host of this game.

login.subtitle: A duel between gentle-wizards
login.error: Sign in failed. Please try again.

handle.title: Handle
handle.desc: 10% chance to duplicate any drawn base element. Socket an element during the match ("Socket" on a base card) to raise it to 20%, but only for that element — every other element drops to no effect.

body.title: Body
body.desc: Socket an element during the match ("Socket" on a base card) for protection from it (1 damage nullified) and vulnerability to its opposite (+1 damage).

effects.opponentDiscardRandom: The opponent discards {amount} card from their hand.

combineDialog.title: Choose which card to use
combineDialog.instructions: More than one card can cover {element}: choose which one to use.

gameSettings.title: Game Settings
gameSettings.confirmText: Are you sure you want to surrender? The game will end immediately.

danger.title: Danger Zone
danger.deleteDesc: Permanently removes your account and all associated data.
danger.confirmText: Are you sure? This action is irreversible. Your account and all your data will be permanently deleted.
danger.reauthRequired: For security, sign out and sign in again before deleting your account.

fire_bolt.name: Fire Bolt
fire_bolt.flavorText: Summoning a Fire Bolt feels really good — you can feel the power flowing from your hands as it bursts out at a distance. Exciting!

water_lance.name: Water Lance
water_lance.flavorText: Ever tried shooting a jet of water at great speed? You get the same effect as a saber strike, just a lot wetter.

air_slash.name: Air Slash
air_slash.flavorText: You won't even hear it coming, and when it hits you, it'll make your head spin like you're caught in a tornado.

earth_shard.name: Earth Shard
earth_shard.flavorText: A shard of earth may look harmless, but thrown with enough force, it becomes a lethal projectile. Nature is powerful and unpredictable.

starter_bolt.name: Starter Spark
starter_bolt.flavorText: The first spell every mage learns — simple, but still leaves a mark.

starter_balm.name: Starter Balm
starter_balm.flavorText: An ancient remedy, passed down to every mage since their first day of apprenticeship.

spore.name: Spore
spore.flavorText: Tiny toxic spores drift on the air, silent and patient — it only takes a few breaths to take hold.

toxin.name: Toxin
toxin.flavorText: A concentrated dose of pure poison: the kind of gift no opponent ever really appreciates.

pestilence.name: Pestilence
pestilence.flavorText: When poison meets shadow, something no antidote can stop in time is born.
